coverage: Reads are worked out in your browser from the daily prices on record for the 1,833 stocks in the daily scoring run, 404 trading days from 2025-03-25 to 2026-10-30. Pattern labels are on record for 1,816 of those names for 2026-10-30; 17 names carry no label for that day and the read says so. Stocks that stopped trading earlier are not in that run and are not on record here.

explanation.body: Its current reading is from 2026-10-30. A graded record of past reads does not exist yet and is not filled in from anything else. The first graded reads arrive after the next scored run's sessions close.
explanation.summary: Pick a stock and read its chart as it stands, in plain language: its trend against its own averages, its key price levels, and its latest pattern labels, every word worked out from the prices on record.

missing.what_and_when: A graded record of past reads does not exist yet and is not filled in from anything else. The first graded reads arrive after the next scored run's sessions close.

rule.averages: The 50-session average is the average of the name's last 50 closing prices, the last session included. The 200-session average is the same count over 200 closing prices.
rule.labels: Pattern labels are the published bar-pattern labels for the name's freshest sessions, carried as labels only, with the meaning printed for each label.
rule.levels: Key levels are the highest high price and the lowest low price over the last 20 sessions, and the same pair over the last 126 sessions, each with the session it fell on.
rule.trend: Trend words, by a fixed rule: the close above both of its averages reads trending up; the close below both reads trending down; any other mix reads mixed, no clear reading.
